children: Global aluminum producer's Q3 revenue declined sequentially and missed analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS and adjusted net income for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company advanced AliGroup acquisition and completed Alumar smelter restart
Alcoa reaffirms 2026 alumina production guidance of 9.5-9.6 mln metric tons
Company maintains 2026 aluminum production outlook at 2.4-2.6 mln metric tons
Alcoa expects higher Q4 production and shipments in both alumina and aluminum segments
ALUMINA SEGMENT - Higher alumina prices and increased shipments supported alumina segment revenue
ALUMINUM SEGMENT - Lower aluminum prices and shipments weighed on aluminum segment revenue
MARK-TO-MARKET GAINS - Favorable mark-to-market changes on Ma’aden shares and energy contracts contributed to net income
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 9 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the aluminum peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Alcoa Corp is $57.50, about 43.5% above its October 14 closing price of $40.08
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 7 three months ago
Oct 14 - Japan Q4 aluminium premiums fall 35% as Middle Eastern supplies recover
Oct 15 - China's aluminium output expected to grow 0.9% in 2027 to 45.7 mln tons, Antaike says
